properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 1274566 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1274566
Incident Time: 2020-03-31 10:30:00
Nearest City: Jamesville, IA
Location: SOUTH OF 1093 250TH STREET
Location2: GRAVEL ROAD
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: AMMONIA, ANHYDROUS
Medium Affected: AIR
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.685864, -92.523598 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 1000 gallon
Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF APPROXIMATELY 1000 GALLONS OF ANHYDROUS AMMONIA INTO THE AIR AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. RELEASE WAS FROM A BROKEN VALVE ON AN ANHYDROUS NURSE TANK THAT WAS BEING PULLED BEHIND A TRACTOR. CALLER STATED THREE TANKS WERE BEING PULLED BY THE TRACTOR AND IT IS BELIEVED THE OPERATOR STRUCK A CURB AND THE 3 TANKS WENT INTO A DITCH. ALL THREE TANKS EACH HAVE APPROXIMATELY 1000 GALLONS OF ANHYDROUS AMMONIA IN THEM. CALLER STATED ONLY ONE TANK APPEARS TO BE LEAKING AND THE PLAN IS TO LET IT COMPLETELY LEAK OUT, SINCE IT IS TO DANGEROUS TO APPROACH AND ATTEMPT TO SECURE IT. CALLER STATED 1 FARM HOUSE WAS EVACUATED THAT CONTAINED 2 PEOPLE AND ANOTHER FARM HOUSE WAS ASKED TO EVACUATE BUT IT IS BELIEVED THEY HAVE NOT DONE SO AT THE MOMENT. NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES WERE REPORTED.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.706115, -84.077670 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 3500 gallon
Report Description
///THIS REPORT WAS RECEIVED VIA THE WEB REPORTING TOOL//// WHILE INITIATING A START-UP OF OUR PROCESS AFTER A SHUT-DOWN OF 9 DAYS FOR MAINTENANCE ONE OF THE EVAPORATOR UNITS IN THE DISTILLATION PORTION BECAME QUICKLY OVER-PRESSURIZED AND A SAFETY PRESSURE RELIEF DISC RELEASED CAUSING STILLAGE MATERIAL THAT WAS SYRUP MIXED WITH WATER. THE PRODUCT AT THIS STAGE IS CONSIDERED AS BIODEGRADABLE THE PRODUCT WAS CONTAINED ON SITE IN A STONED DITCH. A COVERED DRAIN IN THE DITCH WAS IMMEDIATELY FURTHER PROTECTED WITH GRAVEL AND DIRT TO ENSURE THE PRODUCT WOULD NOT EVENTUALLY MAKE IT TO OUR PERMITTED RETENTION POND. AN EPA LICENSED CONTRACTOR WAS ON SITE WITHIN 45 MINUTES AND REMOVING PRODUCT FROM THE GROUND SURFACE. IN ADDITION MAINTENANCE UTILIZED EQUIPMENT TO REMOVE THE TOP LEVEL OF THE STONES FROM THE AREA AND DISPOSED OF AT AN APPROVED SANITARY LANDFILL. WATER WAS USED TO FLUSH DOWN THE AREA . OHIO EPA AND THE ALLEN COUNTY LEPC WAS ALSO NOTIFIED. WAS UNSURE IF THIS INCIDENT NEEDED TO BE REPORTED BUT WANTED TO MAKE SURE OUR COMPANY WAS BEING RESPONSIBLE TO THE ENVIRONMENT.

properties.content:

Nearest City: Orefield, PA
Incident Type: CONTINUOUS
Material: ARSENIC
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
AT THE REQUEST OF ATSDR AND PADEP, THE OSC IS PERFORMING AN INITIAL INVESTIGATION OF ELEVATED CONCENTRATIONS OF ARSENIC IN A FORMER ORCHARD LOCATED IN NORTH WHITEHALL TOWNSHIP, LEHIGH COUNTY, PENNSYLVANIA. A PRIVATE CITIZEN SAMPLED SOIL ON THEIR RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY. LABORATORY ANALYSIS OF THIS SOIL SAMPLE SHOW ARSENIC CONCENTRATIONS OF 140 PPM AT A DEPTH OF 6 TO 12 INCHES. THE RESIDENT CONTACTED AN ATSDR TOXICOLOGIST IN THEIR ATLANTA OFFICE. THE REGIONAL ATSDR REPRESENTATIVE CONTACTED EPA TO REQUEST ASSISTANCE IN INVESTIGATING THIS ISSUE. TOWNSHIP OFFICIALS HAVE STATED THAT APPROXIMATELY 6,000 TO 7,000 ACRES WERE ORCHARDS, WHICH IS ABOUT 1/3 OF THE TOWNSHIP. THE OSC PLANS TO PERFORM AREA-WIDE TESTING TO DETERMINE WHETHER HUMAN-HEALTH ARSENIC EXPOSURES ARE AN ISSUE OR NOT AT THIS SITE. THIS WILL INCLUDE COMPOSITE SOIL SAMPLING AND PRIVATE WELL SAMPLING AT COMPUTER-GENERATED, RANDOMLY SELECTED LOCATIONS FROM THE TOTAL 1435 GRID LOCATIONS WHICH ARE 200 FEET SQUARE. THE SAMPLE GRIDS SELECTED WILL BE APPROXIMATELY 25% OF THESE 1435 GRIDS. THIS PHASE OF THE INVESTIGATION WILL NOT INCLUDE SAMPLING AT ALL RESIDENTIAL OR PUBLIC USE LOCATIONS IN THE SITE AREA. FURTHER SAMPLING DESIGN DECISIONS WILL BE MADE BASED UPON THE RESULTS OF THIS SAMPLING.
